parameters.help_en: The ID of the ENS edge zone
parameters.name: ens_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The CIDR block of the vSwitch. The CIDR block must meet the following requirements:
The subnet mask length of the vSwitch CIDR block must be 16 to 29 bits.
The vSwitch CIDR block must fall within the CIDR block of the VPC to which the vSwitch belongs.
The vSwitch CIDR block cannot be the same as the destination CIDR block of a route entry in the VPC, but it can be a subset of the destination CIDR block
parameters.help_zh:
交换机的网段。交换机网段要求如下：
交换机的网段的掩码长度范围为16~29位。
交换机的网段必须从属于所在VPC的网段。
交换机的网段不能与所在VPC中路由条目的目标网段相同，但可以是目标网段的子集
parameters.name: cidr_block

parameters.help_en:
The name of the vSwitch. The name must meet the following requirements:

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length.
The name must start with a letter or a Chinese character, and cannot start with http:// or https://. It can contain digits, half-width colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

Default value: empty
parameters.help_zh:
交换机名称。命名规则如下：

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。
必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以 http://和https://开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）。

默认值：空
parameters.name: vswitch_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the vSwitch.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
交换机的描述信息。

描述长度为2~256个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，但不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network to which the new vSwitch belongs
parameters.help_zh: 要创建的交换机所属的网络ID
parameters.name: network_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the instance. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

The tag key cannot start with `aliyun`, `acs:`, `http://`, or `https://`.
The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length.
The tag key cannot be an empty string
fields.help_zh:
实例的标签键。N的取值范围为1~20。

不能以`aliyun`、`acs:`、`http://`或`https://`开头。
最多支持64个字符。
不允许传入空字符串
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value of the resource. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with acs: or contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 资源的标签值。N 的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持 128 个字符，不能以acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The IPv6 CIDR block of the vSwitch.

You can specify this parameter to assign an IPv6 CIDR block to the vSwitch only when IPv6 is enabled for the network to which the vSwitch belongs. After the IPv6 CIDR block is assigned, it cannot be changed. Make sure that the IPv6 CIDR block does not overlap with the CIDR blocks of other vSwitches in the same network
parameters.help_zh:
交换机 IPv6 网段。

仅交换机所属网络已开启 IPv6 时，您可以传入此参数为交换机分配 IPv6 网段。IPv6 网段分配后，无法修改为其他网段。需确保与所属网络下其他交换机的网段不重叠
parameters.name: ipv6_cidr_block
